sn35.146:1.1: navapurāṇāni bhikkhave, kammāni desissāmi, kammanirodhañca, kammanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadaṃ.
sn35.146:1.4: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave purāṇaṃ kammaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ vedanīyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. sotaṃ purāṇaṃ kammaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ vedanīyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. ghānaṃ purāṇaṃ kammaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ vedanīyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn35.146:1.5: jivhā purāṇaṃ kammaṃ abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā vedanīyā daṭṭhabbā. kāyo purāṇaṃ kammaṃ abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito vedanīyo daṭṭhabbo.
sn35.146:1.6: mano purāṇaṃ kammaṃ abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito vedanīyo daṭṭhabbo.
sn35.146:1.9: yaṃ kho bhikkhave etarahi kammaṃ karoti kāyena vācāya manasā,
sn35.146:1.12: yo kho bhikkhave kāyakammavacīkammamanokammassa nirodhā vimuttiṃ phusati,
sn35.146:1.16: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
sn35.146:1.18: iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā purāṇaṃ kammaṃ desitaṃ navaṃ kammaṃ, desito kammanirodho, desitā kammanirodhagāminī paṭipadā.
sn35.146:1.19: yaṃ vo bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
sn35.146:1.20: etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. jhāyatha bhikkhave, mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
